dish: Blueberry Wheat Ale and Hillside Daze Blonde Ale from the two-barrel nanobrewery
w: A two-barrel nanobrewery and tasting room set back off Front Street in a former office space, opened by firefighter-homebrewer Kevin McArthur and his wife Abbey. Voted Best Brewery in Akron Life's 2026 330 Flavor Awards (ahead of Hoppin' Frog) and profiled in Cleveland Magazine's Beer Guide.

dish: Country sourdough, German-style rye and hand-rolled German pretzels from a wood-fired brick oven; weekend wood-fired pizza
w: Northeast Ohio's first wood-fired bakery, a European-style shop in Brimfield run by Jud and Genevieve Smith since January 2016, baking 'on a curve' as the 54-square-foot brick oven cools. Named among Cleveland Magazine's best bakeries, featured on WKYC's Behind the Menu, and on Cleveland Scene's list of destination restaurants worth the drive. Marked its 10th anniversary in January 2026.

dish: The Black Squirrel (four espresso shots, mocha, steamed milk) and the hot honey latte with jalapeño
w: A downtown Kent coffeehouse since 2007 with house-roasted organic beans and a board-game library, a Kent State student haunt. Readers voted it Best Coffee in Kent in the student paper's Best of Kent polls in 2023, 2024 and 2026, and it appears in Cleveland Magazine's coffee guide and Akron Life's coffee features.

dish: Homemade pappardelle with wild-boar Bolognese; pork-shank osso buco
w: Veteran Cleveland restaurateur Carl Quagliata's suburban Italian room in Aurora, with a Roman chef and a long menu from antipasti to gnocchi and lasagna. On Cleveland Scene's list of destination restaurants worth the drive, and featured in Akron Life's 'A Taste of Italy'.

dish: Louisiana crawfish Monica with gemelli pasta, corn-fried Gulf oysters, jambalaya and étouffée; homemade ravioli; peanut butter pie
w: Chef-owner David Russo's Italian-Cajun roadhouse, opened August 2002 on State Road (a Peninsula address, though the building is in Cuyahoga Falls), with the bar wrapped around the hot line. Russo spent 13 years in Louisiana kitchens under Paul Prudhomme and Emeril Lagasse. Reviewed by Cleveland Magazine ('Down South') and Cleveland Scene ('Russo's on the Rise'), featured by Akron Life, and listed among Akron Life's 2026 330 Flavor Awards results.

dish: Ma Barker birch beer (birch, lactose, local maple syrup); barbecue chicken Gouda mac made with the birch-beer barbecue sauce
w: A brewpub inside Garrettsville's 1804 water-powered grist mill on Eagle Creek, with a 1977 waterwheel, copper vats on the balcony and creekside decks. Featured by Akron Life ('Water wheel dining') and in Ohio Magazine's '3 Historic Ohio Mills You Can Visit'; later on Food Network's Restaurant Impossible. Hosted Kent State's 2026 Coaches Caravan.

dish: Sunday-brunch Maine lobster frittata with triple-cream Brie and quinoa hash browns
w: The original Rosewood Grill, a contemporary American grill in downtown Hudson with a patio and fire pit. It takes no reservations and the waits are long. Voted Best Brunch in Akron Life's 330 Flavor Awards in 2023 and 2026, and reviewed by Cleveland Magazine ('Worth the Wait').
